nodes.label: cuda-crop-cpp executable target
nodes.rationale: C++17 (CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17, extensions off), strict warnings (-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic), CMake >= 3.20; builds src/main.cpp into the cuda-crop-cpp sidecar binary.

nodes.label: [Anime] conditional profile (Anime4K v4.x Mode A)
nodes.rationale: Replaces (not stacks) the shader list with Anime4K Mode A + KrigBilateral; height-gated <1600 and HDR-excluded so 4K/HDR fall back to the SSim chain.

nodes.label: uosc (UI)
nodes.rationale: osc=no in mpv.conf is load-bearing — uosc replaces mpv's built-in OSC.

nodes.label: Gotcha: conditional profiles need profile-restore=copy-equal
nodes.rationale: Without profile-restore=copy-equal a conditional profile's options leak across files, making behavior session-order dependent.

nodes.label: Gotcha: msg-level is a list option (one line only)
nodes.rationale: Repeated msg-level= lines clobber each other (last wins) because it is a list option; it must appear on a single line.
nodes.norm_label: gotcha: msg-level is a list option (one line only)

nodes.label: Gotcha: mp.options identifier sharing via dofile
nodes.rationale: A script loaded via dofile inherits the parent's script name, so read_options without an explicit identifier reads the parent's script-opts prefix; the legacy crop backend uses dynamic_crop_legacy-* for this reason.
nodes.norm_label: gotcha: mp.options identifier sharing via dofile

nodes.label: Convention: key precedence conf > env > dotenv
nodes.rationale: Non-empty conf value > env var > ~~/.env dotenv (config.lua); .env is the canonical secret store, key-bearing confs are gitignored and keys must never be logged.
nodes.norm_label: convention: key precedence conf > env > dotenv

nodes.label: Gotcha: Lua pattern limits (no {n,m}, no alternation)
nodes.rationale: Lua patterns lack {n,m} quantifiers and | alternation; normalize() in anime_detect uses %d%d%d%d?p and per-token gsub loops with %f[] frontiers for that reason.
nodes.norm_label: gotcha: lua pattern limits (no {n,m}, no alternation)

nodes.label: Convention: zstd at rest, resolve-on-read via hot dir
nodes.rationale: Compress at rest (.zst), never store raw long-term; readers resolve logical names through a hot dir. The util/zstd.lua module is shared between ar_subs and autosubsync.
nodes.norm_label: convention: zstd at rest, resolve-on-read via hot dir

nodes.label: Convention: autosubsync transform-cache tied to retimed path
nodes.rationale: Transform-cache entries carry the retimed file path, so wiping the ar_subs store self-invalidates them; both caches live under ~/.cache/mpv/ so a single wipe stays consistent.
nodes.norm_label: convention: autosubsync transform-cache tied to retimed path

nodes.label: zstd-19 compressed-at-rest cache
nodes.rationale: Subs and refs stored compressed (.ass.zst/.srt.zst, zstd-19 via in-process LuaJIT FFI, no subprocess) under one cache root, decompressed into an LRU hot/ dir on load in sub-milliseconds; keeps disk footprint small while load stays instant.
